notes: Sony's own listing shows no ANC/Ambient on this model, so it is in sony-bridge's NO_MODES rather than MODELS: the bridge asks it nothing at all — not 0x17, not f2 10 — and exits EXIT_UNSUPPORTED right after the handshake, the same 'linked but silent' path the shell already parks without an error banner. This is despite the headset answering NCASM GET 0x17 with a plausible-looking block when asked directly (docs/captures/sony-wh-ch520.txt, run 1): a SET built on that block was ACKed and never once reflected back across four separate live connections, so the reply is not treated as a real control surface. Battery, over Fast Pair, is unaffected and confirmed separately (docs/captures/sony-wh-ch520-fastpair.txt, docs/captures/sony-wh-ch520-live.json).
